# Additional Material

Potential extension topics:

- SharePoint lists as an alternative to Excel trackers;
- Dataverse for governed business data;
- environment strategy and solution-aware flows;
- service accounts and shared ownership;
- error handling with scopes and failure branches;
- child flows and reusable automation components;
- governance for connectors, data loss prevention policies, and premium licensing.

## Choose an Extension by Learning Need

| Learner need | Prepared extension | What to check in the debrief |
|---|---|---|
| “It worked once; is it ready?” | Use the [learner safe test matrix](../learners/additional_material.qmd#safe-test-matrix) and ask pairs to choose a repeat-run case. | Which step might already have succeeded before a later failure? |
| “Another colleague will maintain it.” | Complete the [flow handover record](../learners/additional_material.qmd#flow-handover-record) for the workshop example. | Can the colleague find the authoritative state, connections and stop procedure? |
| “Requests must remain visible.” | Sketch a SharePoint-list alternative to a workbook tracker. | What identifies each request, and who can read or update it? |
| “Errors disappear into email.” | Demonstrate a failed action and a separate review route using a practice flow. | Does the evidence distinguish technical failure from rejection? |

Use [Microsoft's error-handling guidance](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/power-automate/guidance/coding-guidelines/error-handling) when preparing run-after or scope demonstrations. Keep live demonstrations within the test environment and do not ask learners to enable connectors, create service accounts or change tenant governance during the class.

The [Extra Exercises](extra_exercises.qmd) provide explicit inputs and expected evidence for reminders, mailbox triage and escalation. Select one extension and add its timing to the delivery plan.
